template: Is joint {axis} at the same position at {t1}ms and {t2}ms (tolerance of {eps_1} rad)? Answer only with 'Yes' or 'No'.

answer_format.notes: Classification based on deterministic position evaluation.

template: Has the friction proxy for joint {axis} increased from {t1}ms to {t2}ms (tolerance of {eps_2}%)? Assessed using a symmetric half-window of {delta_1}ms. Answer only with 'Yes' or 'No'.
What is the acceleration of the end effector at {t_ms}ms? Answer only with a tensor of length 3 (X, Y, Z in m/s^2), separated by '_'.

answer_format.notes: 3-element vector of floats formatted as a string.

template: Is an external force detected at {t_ms}ms (threshold of {eps_3} N)? Answer only with 'Yes' or 'No'.
What is the jerk of joint {axis} at {t_ms}ms? Answer only with a numerical value in rad/s^3.
What is the torque magnitude about the {axis_label}-axis at {t_ms}ms? Answer only with a numerical value in Nm.
Rank the joints {joints_list} by their absolute speed at time {t_ms}ms, from highest to lowest. Answer only with a 4-letter string containing the letters A, B, C, and D in your ranked order.

answer_format.notes: Model assigns ranks. Labels A, B, C, D correspond to the 4 listed joints.

template: Which of the following joints are operating within their rated maximum speed at T={t_ms}ms? Answer only with a 4-letter string using T and F (e.g. TFTF), nothing else.

options_schema: Joint {axis_a} is within its rated maximum speed.
Joint {axis_b} is within its rated maximum speed.
Joint {axis_c} is within its rated maximum speed.
Joint {axis_d} is within its rated maximum speed.
answer_format.notes: Ground truth: for each joint i, True iff |feedback_speed_{axis_i}(t)| <= joint_speed_limit_{axis_i} from the machine KG (labelling/machines.json, keyed by machine_id). This is the simplest semantic prior question at L1: the raw signal read is trivial, but the correct threshold is only available from the KG. Without the KG, a model cannot answer reliably.

template: Is the motor current of joint {axis} at T={t_ms}ms within the rated continuous current limit for this robot? Answer only with 'Yes' or 'No'.

answer_format.notes: Ground truth: True iff |effort_current_{axis}(t)| <= rated_current_{axis} from the machine KG. Complements Q8 by targeting a single joint and a different physical limit (current vs speed). A model relying purely on signal magnitude without the rated spec will guess randomly.

template: Describe in one sentence the behaviour of {signal} for joint {axis} over the window [T={t1}ms, T={t2}ms].

answer_format.notes: Rule-based reference answer generated from data (e.g. 'Motor current rises sharply from ~1.2 A to ~4.8 A, consistent with a high-load transient'). Scored with LLM-as-judge. Signal ∈ {effort_current, feedback_speed, feedback_pos}.
